title: SB1577 (2022 Regular): Relating to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2022R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/SB1577/Introduced; sha256 43ebd1f0ce4e04417cb8556fb5c0bc77f959585bc9b1ef2a403d225352c4140a)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed). Penalties by offence number: undetectable firearm manufacture/sale is a Class B felony and possession a Class A misdemeanor; untraceable firearm is a Class B violation, escalating with prior convictions; SECTION 1 (ORS 166.210) adds definitions. Section 4 and 5(1) quotes omit the penalty paragraphs for length. No votes recorded.

operative_text:
SECTION 3 (new): (1)(a) A person may not knowingly manufacture or cause to be manufactured within this state, import into this state, or offer for sale, sell or transfer, an undetectable firearm.
SECTION 3 (new): (b) A violation of paragraph (a) of this subsection is a Class B felony.
SECTION 3 (new): (2)(a) A person may not knowingly possess an undetectable firearm.
SECTION 3 (new): (b) A violation of paragraph (a) of this subsection is a Class A misdemeanor.
SECTION 4 (new): (1) A person may not knowingly possess, manufacture, assemble, cause to be manufactured or assembled, import into this state, offer for sale, sell or transfer an untraceable firearm.
SECTION 4 (new): (3) A person convicted of any offense under this section shall forfeit the untraceable firearm.
SECTION 5 (new): (1)(a) A person may not knowingly import into this state, offer for sale, sell or transfer an unfinished frame or receiver unless:
SECTION 5 (new): (A) The person is a federally licensed gun dealer;
SECTION 5 (new): (2)(a) A person may not knowingly possess an unfinished frame or receiver that is not serialized as provided in subsection (1)(a)(B) of this section, unless:
SECTION 5 (new): (A) The person is a federally licensed gun manufacturer; and
SECTION 5 (new): (B) The unfinished frame or receiver is an unfinished part within a manufacturing process that includes serialization.
SECTION 6 (ORS 166.250): (d) Possesses an unfinished frame or receiver and is prohibited from possessing firearms under paragraph (c) of this subsection.
